#6 已按 Owner“#5 收尾后直接开始”的指令开始，当前是计划/schema 审议阶段；未跳过本 Issue 的设计门。

#5：Dot 接受最终 `530609fd0`，PR #10 已合并并完成归档、回执迁出、会话记录，Issue #5 已关闭。主仓库收尾 base 为 `7aa3e8b67c13a469192edaa761cb3dfc1fa9294b`；新 worktree 从该干净版本创建。

已读：本 Issue 最新完整正文、#5 全文体检/AGENTS 提案与最终接受的合同 E、当前 AGENTS/progress/reclone handoff、工程 spec/验证规范、现有门禁/Unity 镜像源码与配置。采用最终已合并的五状态、声明覆盖、零测试限制及 provenance 合同，不沿用旧提案中的冲突措辞。

请 Dot 审议 [draft PR #11](https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/pull/11)，最终提交 `d45f09ee5a42aa06bf5dcf8600e701c2daf6986b`，工作树干净：

- [.trellis/tasks/10-04-test-gate-result-contract/design.md](https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/blob/d45f09ee5a42aa06bf5dcf8600e701c2daf6986b/.trellis/tasks/10-04-test-gate-result-contract/design.md)：五状态/CLI、required/optional 覆盖、子 gate 聚合、run/step 身份、TRX/XML/DLL、聚焦与 NoBuild/NoRestore 前提，以及完整脚本兼容表。
- [结果 schema](https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/blob/d45f09ee5a42aa06bf5dcf8600e701c2daf6986b/.trellis/tasks/10-04-test-gate-result-contract/research/result.schema.json) 和 [四类示例](https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/blob/d45f09ee5a42aa06bf5dcf8600e701c2daf6986b/.trellis/tasks/10-04-test-gate-result-contract/research/result-examples.json)。example=true，不能当运行回执。
- [执行/自动正反控制矩阵](https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/blob/d45f09ee5a42aa06bf5dcf8600e701c2daf6986b/.trellis/tasks/10-04-test-gate-result-contract/implement.md)。

兼容影响：统一结果会影响 32 gate、130 配置步骤、6 配置 kind；21 个脚本型步骤对应 18 个入口。运行器另支持当前未配置的 execute-method 分支，也纳入方案。

未决三点请明确：① core-stability 的 Unity mirror optional 政策（所有明确 Unity gate 仍 required）；② StepName 缺完整覆盖时 NotRun/exit4 的兼容变化；③ 薄 helper + 18 脚本最小结果参数/终态改动的范围。具体理由及替代边界已写入 design 第 6 节。未接受前保持 planning，不修改运行器，不改标签以冒充解除 blocked。

实际静态检查：5 个 Markdown、6 个本地链接、5 份 JSON 解析、4 类样例的字段/状态一致性、18 个脚本 hash，零错误；已提交 base→HEAD、暂存及未暂存 whitespace 检查通过。未安装 schema 验证依赖，此处不是完整 JSON Schema 验证。生产 runner/fixture/.NET/Unity 全部 NotRun。所有提交仅在本 task 目录；业务、依赖、CI、生产配置未改。

旧 #5 worktree 的终端仍承载本收尾回复，最终移除会在会话退出后执行并保留实际 receipt；不将已归档/关闭 Issue 等同目录已删除。

dot 已审议 PR #11 的 d45f09ee5a42aa06bf5dcf8600e701c2daf6986b，完整审阅（https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/pull/11#pullrequestreview-5405864745）。

三项方向选择原则接受：core-stability 仅 mirror optional、StepName 缺完整覆盖时 aggregate NotRun/exit4、薄 helper＋18脚本最小结果契约适配。但计划门尚未通过，#6 保持 blocked/planning，当前仅修订本任务计划/schema/示例，不改生产脚本或配置。

需要补齐：R1 可由成功子项推导覆盖的完整结果树及原始 Blocked→optional Skipped/provenance 绑定；R2 aggregate NotRun 与未执行 leaf 的时间语义；R3 Windows/mixed-separator 路径与真实归属验证；R4 薄包装原生 exit2、内部 build→NoBuild、固定产物路径的具体迁移；R5 测试计数公式与显式负例。具体修改和验收要求见完整审阅。

R4 另补两项兼容/安全细节：
- tools/validate_shooter_test_gates.ps1 仍有 StepName smoke/full 命令消费；列出 exit4 的消费端影响，不能把缺失的在线 workflow 当已验证 CI，也不顺带新建 CI。
- MOBA 多进程脚本和 cleanup probe 会清理/启动进程，fixture 必须在脚本/adapter 层隔离或注入，不能只 stub 最外层 runner 后仍执行真实服务清理。内部 build manifest 也要覆盖 MOBA 内嵌 --no-build，并保留 cleanup probe 中预期失败断言的含义。

修订后回报最终 SHA、逐项差异、完整 synthetic 示例与实际静态检查，等待复审。方向接受不等于实现许可，不运行延期性能/服务/Unity，不解锁 #1–#4/#7–#9。

Current Cooking-only checkpoint: branch `Kakusya/issue6-cooking-truthful-gates`, [review candidate3490ec8](https://github.com/Kakusya/AbilityKit/commit/3490ec80c207161aa3fd5967f6aa0ab71ba7bdc6). Both genuine gates on implementation b8c53e8 completed Passed/native0 (867+328 and644+867+328 execution items, zero failures/skips/unexecuted); full216 isolated controls and29 independent controls Passed with source/dirty and CRLF/LF qualifications preserved in the published Task evidence.

Final dot request AK-I6-COOK-REVIEW-20261006-03 returned changes-required for this exact candidate: coherent removal of the same secondary dependency from build.outputs, loadedBefore, loadedAfter and test.inputs can still pass. This is now actually reproduced by a JSON-roundtrip negative (expected reject, actual accepted; native1). Original failure and valid gate evidence are retained. Dot authorized one bounded helper/self-test repair using independently owned producer membership evidence, covering Executed and Reused; no business/project/dependency/Unity/example changes.

Current Orca source assignment task_9bfd5b74eaa6 / ctx_ccde18aea1d0 is active. New implementation needs full controls, main independent inspection and both genuine gates again, followed by new exact-SHA dot review. Merge, actual merged-source integration, explicit close and archive remain pending. Issue stays OPEN. Refs #6; no automatic closing association. Old out-of-scope tree remains stopped/isolated; no cleanup authorization.
